mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MAX(IMAGE_PATH) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, IMAGE_NO ) AS MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) PI ON PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EP.PRODUCT_NO, MAX(EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE) AS ACTIVE_EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP INNER JOIN EVENT E ON E.EVENT_NO = EP.EVENT_NO WHERE E.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(E.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(E.END_DATE) GROUP BY EP.PRODUCT_NO ) AED ON AED.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
mapper.select:
SELECT CI.CART_ITEM_NO, CI.OPTION_NO, PO.COLOR_NAME, PO.SIZE_NAME, CI.QUANTITY, P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL(AED.ACTIVE_EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0)) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(PO.STOCK, NVL(P.STOCK, 0)) AS STOCK, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE FROM CART_ITEM CI
INNER JOIN CART C ON C.CART_NO = CI.CART_NO
INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = CI.PRODUCT_NO
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON PO.OPTION_NO = CI.OPTION_NO
WHERE C.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
AND CI.CART_ITEM_NO IN
#{cartItemNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ORDER_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_NO, MEMBER_NO, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ORDER_STATUS, RECEIVER_NAME, RECEIVER_PHONE, ADDRESS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{memberNo}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{address}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_ORDER_ITEM_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM ( ORDER_ITEM_NO, ORDER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_NO, BUSINESS_NO, PRODUCT_PRICE, QUANTITY, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{orderItemNo}, #{orderNo}, #{productNo}, #{optionNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{businessNo}, #{productPrice}, #{quantity}, #{status} )

INSERT INTO SETTLEMENT ( SETTLEMENT_NO, BUSINESS_NO, ORDER_ITEM_NO, TOTAL_AMOUNT, APPLIED_GRADE, APPLIED_RATE, FEE_AMOUNT, SETTLED_AMOUNT, STATUS, SETTLED_AT, CREATED_AT ) SELECT SEQ_SETTLEMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY, B.GRADE_NAME, NVL(B.CUSTOM_RATE, GP.COMMISSION_RATE), /* * [수정] 주문상품별 수수료는 여기서 원 단위 반올림하지 않는다. * NUMBER 컬럼에 소수 계산값을 그대로 보존한 뒤, * 사업자/정산월 단위로 합산할 때 마지막 한 번만 ROUND한다. */ (OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) * NVL(B.CUSTOM_RATE, GP.COMMISSION_RATE) / 100, /* * [수정] 주문상품별 판매대금도 정확한 수수료 계산값을 차감해 저장한다. * 최종 지급·표시 금액은 월 합계 조회 시 원 단위로 반올림한다. */ (OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) - ( (OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) * NVL(B.CUSTOM_RATE, GP.COMMISSION_RATE) / 100 ), 'WAITING', NULL, SYSDATE FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = OI.BUSINESS_NO JOIN GRADE_POLICY GP ON GP.GRADE_NAME = B.GRADE_NAME WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND OI.STATUS = 'PAID' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SETTLEMENT S WHERE S.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT_OPTION SET STOCK = STOCK - #{quantity} WHERE OPTION_NO = #{optionNo} AND STOCK >= #{quantity}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DELIVERY D
INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = D.ORDER_ITEM_NO
WHERE OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
AND D.STATUS IN ( 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED' )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO PRODUCT_OPTION PO USING ( SELECT OI.OPTION_NO, SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS RESTORE_QUANTITY FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND OI.STATUS = 'PAID' AND OI.OPTION_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY OI.OPTION_NO ) R ON (PO.OPTION_NO = R.OPTION_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PO.STOCK = PO.STOCK + R.RESTORE_QUANTITY

MERGE INTO PRODUCT P
USING ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, SUM(QUANTITY) AS RESTORE_QUANTITY FROM ORDER_ITEM WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND STATUS = 'PAID' GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) CANCELED_ITEM
ON ( P.PRODUCT_NO = CANCELED_ITEM.PRODUCT_NO )
WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET P.STOCK = NVL(P.STOCK, 0) + CANCELED_ITEM.RESTORE_QUANTITY

UPDATE ORDER_ITEM
SET STATUS = 'CANCELED'
WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND STATUS = 'PAID'
UPDATE SETTLEMENT S SET S.STATUS = 'REJECTED' WHERE S.STATUS = 'WAITING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = S.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} )
mapper.select:
SELECT ORDER_PAGE.ORDER_NO, ORDER_PAGE.MEMBER_NO, ORDER_PAGE.TOTAL_AMOUNT, ORDER_PAGE.ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_PAGE.RECEIVER_NAME, ORDER_PAGE.RECEIVER_PHONE, ORDER_PAGE.ADDRESS, ORDER_PAGE.CREATED_AT, ORDER_PAGE.PAY_METHOD, ORDER_PAGE.PG_PROVIDER, ORDER_PAGE.FULL_CANCEL_STATUS, ORDER_PAGE.FULL_CANCEL_REJECT_REASON FROM ( SELECT ORDER_DATA.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ORDER_DATA.CREATED_AT DESC, ORDER_DATA.ORDER_NO DESC ) AS RN FROM ( SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.MEMBER_NO, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS, O.CREATED_AT, P.PAY_METHOD, P.PG_PROVIDER,
/* ===================================================== [최근 주문 전체 취소 그룹 상태 조회 추가]
하나의 전체 취소 요청은 주문상품별 여러 행으로 저장되므로 가장 최근 CANCEL_GROUP_NO를 기준으로 그룹 상태를 계산한다. ====================================================== */
( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'WAITING' WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE NULL END FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND CR.CANCEL_TYPE = 'FULL' AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = ( SELECT MAX(CR2.CANCEL_GROUP_NO) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR2 WHERE CR2.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND CR2.CANCEL_TYPE = 'FULL' ) ) AS FULL_CANCEL_STATUS,
( SELECT MAX(CR.REJECT_REASON) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND CR.CANCEL_TYPE = 'FULL' AND CR.STATUS = 'REJECTED' AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = ( SELECT MAX(CR2.CANCEL_GROUP_NO) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR2 WHERE CR2.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND CR2.CANCEL_TYPE = 'FULL' ) ) AS FULL_CANCEL_REJECT_REASON FROM ORDERS O
LEFT JOIN PAYMENT P ON P.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO
WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) ORDER_DATA ) ORDER_PAGE WHERE ORDER_PAGE.RN BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY ORDER_PAGE.RN

SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.ORDER_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, OI.OPTION_NO, PO.COLOR_NAME, PO.SIZE_NAME, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, OI.STATUS, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE, /* [추가] DELIVERY 미등록 결제 상품은 주문 확인중으로 처리 */ NVL(D.STATUS, CASE WHEN OI.STATUS IN ('SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') THEN OI.STATUS ELSE 'CONFIRMED' END ) AS DELIVERY_STATUS,
/* ===================================================== [최근 부분 취소 요청 상태 및 반려 사유 조회]
반려 후 주문상품 상태가 PAID로 복구되더라도 사용자 화면에서 반려 사유를 확인할 수 있도록 가장 최근 PARTIAL 요청 한 건을 조회한다. ====================================================== */ ( SELECT CR.STATUS FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_TYPE = 'PARTIAL' AND CR.CANCEL_NO = ( SELECT MAX(CR2.CANCEL_NO) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR2 WHERE CR2.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR2.CANCEL_TYPE = 'PARTIAL' ) ) AS CANCEL_REQUEST_STATUS,
( SELECT CR.CANCEL_TYPE FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_TYPE = 'PARTIAL' AND CR.CANCEL_NO = ( SELECT MAX(CR2.CANCEL_NO) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR2 WHERE CR2.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR2.CANCEL_TYPE = 'PARTIAL' ) ) AS CANCEL_TYPE,
( SELECT CR.REJECT_REASON FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_TYPE = 'PARTIAL' AND CR.CANCEL_NO = ( SELECT MAX(CR2.CANCEL_NO) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR2 WHERE CR2.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR2.CANCEL_TYPE = 'PARTIAL' ) ) AS CANCEL_REJECT_REASON FROM ORDER_ITEM OI
INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO
INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON PO.OPTION_NO = OI.OPTION_NO
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = OI.BUSINESS_NO
/* [추가] 사용자 버튼 노출 판단을 위한 배송 상태 조인 */ LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO
WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY OI.ORDER_NO DESC, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO ASC

SELECT D.DELIVERY_NO, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.ORDER_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS, D.TRACKING_NUMBER, D.COURIER, NVL(D.STATUS, CASE WHEN OI.STATUS IN ('SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') THEN OI.STATUS ELSE 'CONFIRMED' END ) AS STATUS, O.CREATED_AT AS ORDER_CREATED_AT FROM ORDER_ITEM OI
INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO
INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON PO.OPTION_NO = OI.OPTION_NO
LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO
WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo}
